files.caption: Three photographs of 1615 Sunset Street, Middletown, Ohio. Photographs are undated. The real estate listing for 1615 Sunset Street reads: Cape Cod - 1 1/2 story suburban home. Few minutes from city limits on a large plot of ground. Has 5 rooms on first floor with knotty pine bedroom and dinette. Two unfinished rooms on second floor. Automatic oil heat. Garage. Quick possession.
